content_json.blurb: How Gujarat came to be and how it is run.
content_json.title: Gujarat: History & Governance

sections.body: Capital: Gandhinagar. Official language: Gujarati. Gujarat took its present form in 1960. Longest coastline of any Indian state (~1,600 km).
sections.head: Identity & formation

sections.body: Gujarat elects 182 MLAs to its Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha), who in turn choose the Chief Minister. It sends 26 MPs to the Lok Sabha. The Governor (or Lieutenant Governor) is the constitutional head, and administration runs through 33 districts.
sections.head: How it is governed

sections.body: Under the 73rd & 74th Constitutional Amendments, Gujarat runs villages through gram, block and zilla panchayats and towns through municipalities — with reserved seats for women, SCs & STs, and a Gram Sabha (all village voters) in every panchayat.
sections.head: Local self-government
